title: Factory test suite fails when Python writes bytecode caches during the run
summary: On Linux arm64 with Python 3.13.5, ./.factory/scripts/test reports 12 failures (context export, process check record-content/CLI and task archive tests) because the helpers' __pycache__ directories appear between the before/after tree or git status snapshots the tests compare. With PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 all 197 tests pass. Pre-existing harness behaviour, not caused by the task diff. Next: make the configured test command or the fixtures ignore bytecode caches (e.g. set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE or exclude __pycache__ from snapshots).
evidence: factory-test.txt (plain run, 12 failures) and factory-test-nobytecode.txt (197 passed) in this task; indigo_test/factory/test_context_export.py:93, indigo_test/factory/test_process_check.py:504.
